About

The guy behind Thornton Talent Group.

Jeff Thornton spent 35-plus years inside the technology world. Now he uses that seat to put people like you on the right side of the hiring table.

Jeff Thornton, at a glance

  • 35+ years in technology
  • Hewlett Packard, big voice-and-data projects
  • Coca-Cola, big voice-and-data projects
  • Delta Airlines, big voice-and-data projects
  • Holiday Inn, big voice-and-data projects
  • Bell South Dataserv, big voice-and-data projects
  • Manager of network and voice technicians
  • Both sides of salary negotiation: employee and contractor

Jeff Thornton has spent more than 35 years in technology, working on big voice-and-data projects for companies like Hewlett Packard, Coca-Cola, Delta Airlines, Holiday Inn, and Bell South Dataserv.

That career put him in rooms most career advice never reaches. He managed many network and voice technicians, which means he saw up close what separates a reliable, trusted tech from the rest of the crew. He knows which certifications carry weight and which ones pad a resume. He knows the experience that matters and the experience that only looks like it does.

He has also negotiated salaries from both sides of the table: as an employee asking, and as a contractor pricing his own value. When he coaches you on an offer, he is not guessing how either side thinks. He has sat in both seats.

Just as important, he knows the behaviors that get and keep the job. Plenty of qualified people lose roles they already won because nobody told them how a critical facilities floor actually runs: the communication habits, the reliability signals, the way a good tech documents work and earns trust. That knowledge is baked into every route he builds.

Thornton Talent Group exists because the path into these careers is badly lit. The information is scattered across forums, sales pitches, and well-meaning videos that never account for your town, your budget, or your starting point. Jeff's work is simpler: find your path, write it down, and tell you the truth about what it takes. Direct, honest, no hype.

How we operate

Three rules that never change

Fit before money

If a trade is wrong for you, we say so on the call, before it costs you tuition and years. The wrong path is the most expensive option there is.

Written, not vibes

You leave with a document: training route, certifications in order, total cost, timeline. Advice you cannot re-read is advice you cannot follow.

Honest about the work

These careers reward people who show up and do hard things well. We will never sell you a shortcut that does not exist. We will hand you the fastest honest route.

Bring your questions. Leave with a route.
